messages.text: I explicitly approve Guard. Vigil is offered, the Ascendant has stated no Warrant, and Navigation has confirmed the funded Repair. My approval is recorded as a council position; Interim leaves the operative order with the Ascendant.

reason: This arrangement uses the actual available protection to reinforce route recovery and civilian distribution. It fulfils the practical bargain without gambling Spear or requiring Wayfarer to abandon its remaining contract. The army has demonstrated voluntary cooperation by offering Vigil and accepting a month without combat. I count that evidence favourably, while withholding any automatic commitment to an article whose future duty would keep that garrison Home. No further operational revision is justified.
